title: Altitude 101

detailBlocks.content:
Altitude.101 is a Paris-based company specializing in photography and videography. It creates high-impact visual content with a flexible, innovative, and excellence-driven approach.

For this project, I designed and developed an immersive showcase website reflecting the brand's visual universe and creative positioning. The goal was to translate its identity through a strong, dynamic, and contemporary digital experience.

On the development side, the site relies on Three.js and WebGL for interactive visual rendering, Matter.js for physics effects and dynamic interactions, and GSAP for smooth and precise animations. Together, they create an engaging experience consistent with Altitude.101's premium and innovative image.
Based in Paris, Altitude 101 is a video production studio crafting immersive films for Apple Vision Pro, shot with Blackmagic cameras to deliver cinematic experiences beyond the screen.

detailBlocks.heading: Altitude 101 — from mobile storytelling to desktop cinema.
paragraphs: The project was conceived as a continuous experience: on mobile, the interface prioritizes reading rhythm and access speed; on desktop, the staging favors immersive media, smooth transitions, and visual depth.

The loader introduces the artistic direction with a progressive animation of visual layers. It serves to mask video loading times, preload critical media, and immediately establish the project's identity.
The responsive behavior maintains the same graphic signature, but adjusts the hierarchy, content density, and shot ratios to maintain a consistent impact across all screens.

description: Immersive web experience, Three.js, WebGL and GSAP.

title: Rubens

detailBlocks.content:
Rubens is a variation of Helmet, conceived as a new visual exploration around the infinite vertical carousel.

The idea was to take this interactive foundation and push it in a more editorial and expressive direction, working more deeply on composition, rhythm, and the presence of visuals in space.

The project was developed with React Three Fiber and Three.js, as an experimentation around staging and movement in real-time 3D.

description: Infinite vertical carousel, editorial direction with R3F.

title: Dithering

detailBlocks.content:
Dithering is a personal project that is part of a series of visual and technical experiments.

In this test, I explore dithering, a rendering technique that simulates shades and gradients using dot or halftone patterns, often used to give an image a rougher, graphic, or retro texture.

The effect was developed in post-processing using a WebGL shader, with a stack based on Three.js and WebGL.

description: WebGL post-processing — visual exploration of dithering.

title: HELMET

detailBlocks.content:
Helmet is an experimentation project around building an infinite vertical carousel with a creative and immersive aesthetic.

Developed with React Three Fiber and Three.js, this test allowed me to explore new animation and composition approaches in real-time 3D.

The project later gave rise to an article on Codrops, in which the effect is explained in detail, as well as a variation titled Rubens.

description: Infinite 3D carousel, R3F experimentation on Codrops.

title: LABNOIR
description: Generative maze around the theme of anxiety.

detailBlocks.content:
LABNOIR is an interactive experience created in two days at Gobelins around the theme of anxiety.

I designed a generative maze in vanilla JavaScript, with Three.js and WebGL for rendering and post-processing.

title: MATZO
description: Narrative mini-game in a dark universe.

detailBlocks.content:
Matzo is a narrative mini-game currently in development.

The player embodies a small character lost in darkness, searching for their path and their friend Jo, in a universe that is fragile, silent, and enigmatic.

The project blends exploration, puzzle-solving, and narrative progression, with a desire to build an experience driven as much by atmosphere as by gameplay. Through movement, environmental elements, and obstacles encountered, the player gradually discovers a dim, mysterious world where each advance reinforces the connection between story, space, and sensation.

Conceived as both a sensitive and immersive experience, Matzo revolves around a gentle, contemplative, and slightly unsettling atmosphere, where the shadows become both a setting and a narrative language.
